name: Syphilis
general: Confirm with VDRL/RPR (titre) + TPHA. Test for HIV; examine and treat partners (primary: 3 months, secondary: 6 months, early latent: 1 year). Follow titres at 3, 6, 12 months — expect 4-fold fall.
special: Pregnancy: penicillin only — desensitise if allergic; treat partner; newborn evaluation.

rx.instr: After test dose per NACO; warn about Jarisch–Herxheimer reaction

rx.drug: Neurosyphilis: Inj. Aqueous crystalline penicillin 18–24 MU/day (3–4 MU 4-hourly)
